Write each open port as protocol/port, s.es: Escribe cada puerto abierto como protocolo/puerto, como udp/13231 o tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.pt-BR: Escreva cada porta aberta como protocolo/porta, como udp/13231 ou tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.fr: Écrivez chaque port ouvert sous la forme protocole/port, par exemple udp/13231 ou tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.de: Schreiben Sie jeden offenen Port als Protokoll/Port, etwa udp/13231 oder tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.id: Tulis tiap port terbuka sebagai protokol/port, misalnya udp/13231 atau tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.it: Scrivi ogni porta aperta come protocollo/porta, ad esempio udp/13231 o tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.tr: Her açık portu protokol/port biçiminde yazın, örneğin udp/13231 veya tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.vi: Ghi mỗi cổng mở theo dạng giao thức/cổng, ví dụ udp/13231 hoặc tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.ru: Записывайте каждый открытый порт в виде протокол/порт, например udp/13231 или tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.pl: Wpisz każdy otwarty port jako protokół/port, na przykład udp/13231 lub tcp/8443.
Write each open port as protocol/port, s.hi: हर खुला पोर्ट protocol/port के रूप में लिखें, जैसे udp/13231 या tcp/8443।

{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..fr: {name} ne peut pas être à la fois WAN et LAN.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..de: {name} kann nicht zugleich WAN und LAN sein.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..id: {name} tidak bisa sekaligus WAN dan LAN.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..it: {name} non può essere sia WAN sia LAN.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..vi: {name} không thể vừa là WAN vừa là LAN.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..ru: {name} не может быть одновременно WAN и LAN.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..pl: Interfejs {name} nie może być jednocześnie WAN i LAN.
{name} can't be both WAN and LAN..hi: {name} एक साथ WAN और LAN नहीं हो सकता।

0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.es: 0.0.0.0/0 en la lista de administración deja que todo internet llegue a WinBox y SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.pt-BR: 0.0.0.0/0 na lista de gerenciamento deixa toda a internet alcançar o WinBox e o SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.fr: 0.0.0.0/0 dans la liste d'administration permet à tout internet d'atteindre WinBox et SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.de: 0.0.0.0/0 in der Management-Liste lässt das ganze Internet WinBox und SSH erreichen.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.id: 0.0.0.0/0 di daftar manajemen membuat seluruh internet bisa menjangkau WinBox dan SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.it: 0.0.0.0/0 nella lista di gestione permette a tutta Internet di raggiungere WinBox e SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.tr: Yönetim listesindeki 0.0.0.0/0, tüm internetin WinBox ve SSH'ye erişmesine izin verir.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.vi: 0.0.0.0/0 trong danh sách quản trị cho phép toàn bộ Internet truy cập WinBox và SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.ru: Адрес 0.0.0.0/0 в списке управления открывает доступ к WinBox и SSH всему интернету.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.pl: 0.0.0.0/0 na liście zarządzania daje całemu internetowi dostęp do WinBox i SSH.
0.0.0.0/0 in the management list lets th.hi: मैनेजमेंट लिस्ट में 0.0.0.0/0 होने से पूरा इंटरनेट WinBox और SSH तक पहुँच सकता है।

Some management entries had host bits se.es: Algunas entradas de administración tenían bits de host; el script usa su dirección de red.
Some management entries had host bits se.pt-BR: Algumas entradas de gerenciamento tinham bits de host ligados; o script usa o endereço de rede delas.
Some management entries had host bits se.fr: Certaines entrées d'administration avaient des bits d'hôte définis ; le script utilise leur adresse réseau.
Some management entries had host bits se.de: Einige Management-Einträge hatten gesetzte Host-Bits; das Skript verwendet ihre Netzadresse.
Some management entries had host bits se.id: Beberapa entri manajemen memiliki bit host; skrip memakai alamat network-nya.
Some management entries had host bits se.it: Alcune voci di gestione avevano i bit host impostati; lo script usa il loro indirizzo di rete.
Some management entries had host bits se.tr: Bazı yönetim girişlerinde ana makine bitleri ayarlıydı; betik bunların ağ adresini kullanır.
Some management entries had host bits se.vi: Một số mục quản trị có bit host được đặt; tập lệnh sẽ dùng địa chỉ mạng của chúng.
Some management entries had host bits se.ru: В некоторых записях управления были заданы биты хоста; скрипт использует адрес их сети.
Some management entries had host bits se.pl: Niektóre wpisy zarządzania miały ustawione bity hosta; skrypt używa ich adresu sieci.
Some management entries had host bits se.hi: कुछ मैनेजमेंट एंट्री में होस्ट बिट सेट थे; स्क्रिप्ट उनका नेटवर्क एड्रेस इस्तेमाल करती है।

Replace mode deletes all existing filter.es: El modo reemplazo elimina todas las reglas de filter y NAT existentes, incluidos los port forwards. Copia primero lo que quieras conservar.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.pt-BR: O modo de substituição apaga todas as regras de filter e NAT existentes, incluindo os port forwards. Copie antes o que quiser manter.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.fr: Le mode remplacement supprime toutes les règles filter et NAT existantes, redirections de ports comprises. Copiez d'abord ce que vous voulez conserver.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.de: Der Ersetzungsmodus löscht alle vorhandenen Filter- und NAT-Regeln, auch Portweiterleitungen. Kopieren Sie vorher alles, was Sie behalten wollen.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.id: Replace mode menghapus semua aturan filter dan NAT yang ada, termasuk port forward. Salin dulu apa pun yang ingin dipertahankan.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.it: La modalità sostituzione elimina tutte le regole filter e NAT esistenti, inclusi i port forward. Copia prima ciò che vuoi conservare.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.tr: Değiştirme modu, port yönlendirmeleri dahil mevcut tüm filtre ve NAT kurallarını siler. Saklamak istediklerinizi önce kopyalayın.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.vi: Chế độ thay thế sẽ xóa toàn bộ quy tắc filter và NAT hiện có, kể cả chuyển tiếp cổng. Hãy sao chép trước những gì bạn muốn giữ lại.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.ru: Режим замены удаляет все существующие правила filter и NAT, включая проброс портов. Сначала скопируйте всё, что хотите сохранить.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.pl: Tryb zastępowania usuwa wszystkie istniejące reguły filtrowania i NAT, w tym przekierowania portów. Najpierw skopiuj to, co chcesz zachować.
Replace mode deletes all existing filter.hi: Replace मोड राउटर के सभी मौजूदा फ़िल्टर और NAT रूल हटा देता है, पोर्ट फ़ॉरवर्ड भी। जो रखना चाहें, पहले उसकी कॉपी कर लें।

The rules are added after any rules the.es: Las reglas se agregan después de las que el router ya tenga. Revisa el orden con /ip firewall filter print, o usa el modo reemplazo en un router nuevo.
The rules are added after any rules the.pt-BR: As regras são adicionadas depois das que o roteador já tem. Confira a ordem com /ip firewall filter print ou use o modo de substituição em um roteador novo.
The rules are added after any rules the.fr: Les règles sont ajoutées après celles que le routeur possède déjà. Vérifiez l'ordre avec /ip firewall filter print, ou utilisez le mode remplacement sur un routeur neuf.
The rules are added after any rules the.de: Die Regeln werden hinter den Regeln hinzugefügt, die der Router schon hat. Prüfen Sie die Reihenfolge mit /ip firewall filter print oder verwenden Sie den Ersetzungsmodus auf einem frischen Router.
The rules are added after any rules the.id: Aturan ditambahkan setelah aturan yang sudah ada di router. Periksa urutannya dengan /ip firewall filter print, atau gunakan replace mode pada router baru.
The rules are added after any rules the.it: Le regole vengono aggiunte dopo quelle già presenti sul router. Controlla l'ordine con /ip firewall filter print, oppure usa la modalità sostituzione su un router appena configurato.
The rules are added after any rules the.tr: Kurallar, yönlendiricide zaten bulunan kuralların ardına eklenir. Sırayı /ip firewall filter print ile kontrol edin veya yeni bir yönlendiricide değiştirme modunu kullanın.
The rules are added after any rules the.vi: Các quy tắc được thêm vào sau những quy tắc router đã có. Hãy kiểm tra thứ tự bằng /ip firewall filter print, hoặc dùng chế độ thay thế trên router mới.
The rules are added after any rules the.ru: Правила добавляются после тех, что уже есть на маршрутизаторе. Проверьте порядок командой /ip firewall filter print или используйте режим замены на чистом маршрутизаторе.
The rules are added after any rules the.pl: Reguły są dodawane po regułach, które router już ma. Sprawdź kolejność poleceniem /ip firewall filter print albo użyj trybu zastępowania na świeżym routerze.
The rules are added after any rules the.hi: ये रूल राउटर में पहले से मौजूद रूल के बाद जुड़ते हैं। क्रम /ip firewall filter print से जाँचें, या नए राउटर पर replace मोड इस्तेमाल करें।

With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.es: Con la LAN sin confianza, solo las subredes de administración llegan a WinBox y SSH. Asegúrate de que la computadora desde la que administras esté en una de ellas.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.pt-BR: Com a LAN não confiável, apenas as sub-redes de gerenciamento alcançam o WinBox e o SSH. Confirme que o computador de onde você gerencia está em uma delas.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.fr: Le LAN n'étant pas de confiance, seuls les sous-réseaux d'administration atteignent WinBox et SSH. Assurez-vous que l'ordinateur depuis lequel vous administrez fait partie de l'un d'eux.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.de: Bei nicht vertrauenswürdigem LAN erreichen nur die Management-Subnetze WinBox und SSH. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Rechner, von dem aus Sie verwalten, in einem davon liegt.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.id: Dengan LAN tidak dipercaya, hanya subnet manajemen yang bisa menjangkau WinBox dan SSH. Pastikan komputer yang Anda pakai untuk mengelola ada di salah satunya.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.it: Con la LAN non attendibile, solo le subnet di gestione raggiungono WinBox e SSH. Assicurati che il computer da cui gestisci il router sia in una di esse.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.tr: LAN güvenilmez olduğunda WinBox ve SSH'ye yalnızca yönetim alt ağları erişebilir. Yönetim yaptığınız bilgisayarın bunlardan birinde olduğundan emin olun.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.vi: Khi LAN không được tin cậy, chỉ các mạng con quản trị mới truy cập được WinBox và SSH. Hãy đảm bảo máy tính bạn dùng để quản lý nằm trong một trong số đó.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.ru: Если LAN не считается доверенной, к WinBox и SSH получат доступ только подсети управления. Убедитесь, что компьютер, с которого вы управляете, входит в одну из них.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.pl: Gdy LAN jest niezaufany, do WinBox i SSH mają dostęp tylko podsieci zarządzania. Upewnij się, że komputer, z którego zarządzasz, jest w jednej z nich.
With the LAN untrusted, only the managem.hi: LAN को अविश्वसनीय मानने पर सिर्फ़ मैनेजमेंट सबनेट ही WinBox और SSH तक पहुँच पाते हैं। पक्का करें कि जिस कंप्यूटर से आप मैनेज करते हैं, वह इनमें से किसी एक में हो।

FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.es: FastTrack está activo: el tráfico con fasttrack se salta las queues, mangle y las políticas IPsec. Desactívalo si limitas el tráfico con simple queues o queue trees.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.pt-BR: O FastTrack está ligado: o tráfego com fasttrack pula queues, mangle e políticas IPsec. Desligue-o se você limita o tráfego com simple queues ou queue trees.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.fr: FastTrack est activé : le trafic en fasttrack contourne les queues, mangle et les politiques IPsec. Désactivez-le si vous limitez le trafic avec des simple queues ou des queue trees.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.de: FastTrack ist an: FastTrack-Verkehr überspringt Queues, Mangle und IPsec-Policies. Schalten Sie es aus, wenn Sie Verkehr mit Simple Queues oder Queue Trees begrenzen.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.id: FastTrack aktif: lalu lintas yang di-fasttrack melewati queue, mangle, dan kebijakan IPsec. Matikan jika Anda membatasi lalu lintas dengan simple queue atau queue tree.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.it: FastTrack è attivo: il traffico in fasttrack salta code, mangle e policy IPsec. Disattivalo se limiti il traffico con simple queue o queue tree.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.tr: FastTrack açık: fasttrack trafiği kuyrukları, mangle'ı ve IPsec ilkelerini atlar. Trafiği simple queue veya queue tree ile şekillendiriyorsanız kapatın.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.vi: FastTrack đang bật: lưu lượng fasttrack bỏ qua queue, mangle và chính sách IPsec. Hãy tắt nếu bạn định hình lưu lượng bằng simple queue hoặc queue tree.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.ru: FastTrack включён: ускоренный трафик обходит очереди, mangle и политики IPsec. Отключите его, если вы ограничиваете трафик простыми очередями или деревьями очередей.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.pl: FastTrack jest włączony: ruch objęty fasttrack omija kolejki, mangle i polityki IPsec. Wyłącz go, jeśli kształtujesz ruch za pomocą simple queue lub drzew kolejek.
FastTrack is on: fasttracked traffic ski.hi: FastTrack चालू है: फ़ास्टट्रैक किया गया ट्रैफ़िक queues, mangle और IPsec पॉलिसी को छोड़ देता है। अगर आप simple queues या queue tree से ट्रैफ़िक शेप करते हैं, तो इसे बंद करें।

WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.es: WebFig (www y www-ssl) y la API quedan desactivados. Desmarca la opción de servicios si los usas.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.pt-BR: O WebFig (www e www-ssl) e a API estão desativados. Desmarque a opção de serviços se você os usa.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.fr: WebFig (www et www-ssl) et l'API sont désactivés. Décochez l'option des services si vous les utilisez.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.de: WebFig (www und www-ssl) und die API werden abgeschaltet. Entfernen Sie den Haken bei der Dienste-Option, wenn Sie sie nutzen.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.id: WebFig (www dan www-ssl) dan API dimatikan. Hapus centang opsi layanan jika Anda memakainya.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.it: WebFig (www e www-ssl) e l'API sono disattivati. Deseleziona l'opzione dei servizi se li usi.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.tr: WebFig (www ve www-ssl) ile API kapatıldı. Bunları kullanıyorsanız hizmetler seçeneğinin işaretini kaldırın.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.vi: WebFig (www và www-ssl) và API đã bị tắt. Hãy bỏ chọn tùy chọn dịch vụ nếu bạn dùng chúng.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.ru: WebFig (www и www-ssl) и API отключены. Снимите флажок служб, если они вам нужны.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.pl: WebFig (www i www-ssl) oraz API są wyłączone. Odznacz opcję usług, jeśli z nich korzystasz.
WebFig (www and www-ssl) and the API are.hi: WebFig (www और www-ssl) और API बंद हैं। अगर आप इन्हें इस्तेमाल करते हैं, तो services वाला विकल्प अनचेक करें।
